rules.description: Aadhaar number is not required for students applying for the scholarship at present.
rules.condition: When a student applies for the scholarship currently (before the Gazette Notification takes effect).
rules.outcome: The student may omit providing an Aadhaar number.
rules.evidence_quote: Aadhaar Number is optional for the students at present.

rules.description: Eligible applicants must provide their Aadhaar number when applying for the scholarship after the Gazette Notification.
rules.condition: For eligible applicants after the Gazette Notification dated 21st April 2017.
rules.outcome: Aadhaar number must be submitted with the scholarship application.
exceptions: If the applicant does not possess an Aadhaar number, alternative identification documents may be submitted as specified in the Gazette Notification.
rules.evidence_quote: it will be necessary for the eligible applicants to provide Aadhaar number while applying for the scholarship

rules.description: Applicants without an Aadhaar number may submit alternative identification documents as specified in the Gazette Notification.
rules.condition: If an applicant does not possess an Aadhaar number.
rules.outcome: Provide details of alternative identification documents (e.g., Aadhaar Enrolment ID slip).
